## Purpose and package layout
FastMCP is a Python framework for building MCP servers, clients, and conversational interactive apps. The main distributable implementation is `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/`; companion packages provide a remote CLI and durable task support: `fastmcp_remote/fastmcp_remote/` and `fastmcp_tasks/fastmcp_tasks/`.

## Primary entry points
Library users import `FastMCP` from `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/__init__.py` and construct servers through `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/server.py`. The command-line entry point is organized in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/cli/cli.py` and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/cli/__main__.py`; it runs servers, connects clients, generates commands, installs MCP configurations, and deploys to Horizon. Remote-only usage is exposed by `fastmcp_remote/fastmcp_remote/cli.py`.

## Server composition and component model
`fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/server.py` coordinates MCP lifecycle, registration, request dispatch, sessions, and transports. Application code becomes typed MCP tools, resources, and prompts via:
- `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/tools/function_tool.py`
- `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/resources/function_resource.py`
- `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/prompts/function_prompt.py`

Providers are the server’s principal composition boundary: local decorated Python components, mounted/proxied servers, filesystem discovery, OpenAPI-derived endpoints, and skills are normalized behind `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/providers/base.py`, with implementations in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/providers/local_provider/local_provider.py` and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/providers/proxy.py`.

## Request path, transports, and state
An MCP request enters through stdio or HTTP transport handling, principally `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/http.py` and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/mixins/transport.py`. It passes configured middleware—for authorization, caching, rate/error/response controls, logging, and tool injection—under `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/middleware/`. Server context, lifecycle dependencies, session ownership, and event persistence are bounded in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/context.py`, `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/sessions.py`, and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/event_store.py`.

## Policy, adaptation, and observability
Authentication supports bearer/JWT verification, OAuth/OIDC proxying, identity assertions, and many hosted identity providers. The boundary is `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/auth/auth.py`, with provider adapters under `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/auth/providers/` and proxy flow in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/auth/oauth_proxy/proxy.py`. Provider catalogs can be transformed for namespace/version/visibility, tool search, or exposing prompts/resources as tools through `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/transforms/`. Server and client telemetry live in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/telemetry.py` and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/client/telemetry.py`.

## Client and external-service boundary
`fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/client/client.py` manages protocol initialization, discovery, calls, progress, roots, notifications, and caching against arbitrary MCP servers. Transport selection is isolated in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/client/transports/` (HTTP, SSE, stdio, memory, inference). Client OAuth and credentials are under `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/client/auth/`; sampling adapters integrate Anthropic, Google GenAI, and OpenAI via `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/client/sampling/handlers/`.

## Apps, tasks, and deployment infrastructure
Interactive app primitives and prefab UI payloads reside in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/apps/app.py` and `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/providers/prefab_synthesis.py`. Optional durable/background task execution is a separate package with worker wiring, encrypted snapshots, input handling, and lifecycle extension in `fastmcp_tasks/fastmcp_tasks/wire_production.py`, `fastmcp_tasks/fastmcp_tasks/encryption.py`, and `fastmcp_tasks/fastmcp_tasks/worker_cli.py`. Horizon is the external deployment/gateway service, integrated through `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/cli/deploy/horizon_client.py`.
